description:
local_call_targets (jobs/runtime_demand.rs:1198) collects a Vec<ExecutableKey> per call site; all four callers iterate once (:522, :1017, :979, :621), and result_consumers asks again per feeding site. About 5.9k allocations. Return an iterator.
World::waits_reach (drive.rs:920/923, from answer_use :948) allocates pending and a seen HashSet before the walk; the usual from has no standing waits. About 8k. Return false first when waits_for(from) is empty.
World::reference_function (world.rs:1189) clones the module denotation on every call; functions.reference (identity.rs:550) looks the key up first and discards the clone on a hit. About 4k. Pass Option<&ModuleDenotation> (modules and functions are separate fields) and clone on insert.
apply_proofs (dispatch_reachability.rs:160) clones ReachabilityState per edge even when proofs is empty or changes nothing; :217 copies roots per alternative. About 10k small allocations. Return the incoming state when nothing changes.
Each site is its own claim; land the ones that come out simpler.

Counts are sampling estimates at develop 742e688b5 (line numbers refer to /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz/464fcf92-8f92-4767-a8fb-4e4eea4b6d45/scratchpad/census/wt-alloc/src); re-measure on your base first. Signal: see the epic.
title: Analysis helpers answer without collecting what the caller reads once
